subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Gateway/OpenResponses binary `input_file` workspace receipt contract for Excel and allowlisted binaries, or narrow this issue to a smaller Excel-only/default-allowlist change while routing generic binary and provider-native behavior elsewhere?
rationale: The source gap is real, but solving it defines public upload, storage, redaction, backup, tool-access, and security semantics that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Core Binary Receipts
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Gateway workspace/persistence contract and require explicit MIME, size, URL, redaction, metadata, and tool-access rules before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Excel Receipts
options.body: Limit this issue to allowlisted Excel persistence and leave generic binary/provider-native forwarding to broader file-input trackers.

options.title: Defer To Plugin Or ClawHub Design
options.body: Leave core behavior unchanged until a plugin or ClawHub package proves the workflow and any missing extension APIs are clear.

recommendation.title: Approve Core Binary Receipts
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Gateway workspace/persistence contract and require explicit MIME, size, URL, redaction, metadata, and tool-access rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined Gateway/OpenResponses history and were explicitly pulled into the issue discussion for product direction.
